name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
label: Quest
description: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning.

Kormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance.
But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I commend you, friend, if you have returned with the left piece of the amulet. If not, however, please take care of that as there is no time to waste, I assure you!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good work, friend! Kormok wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. But, there is more work ahead of us.

Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
